Since there isn't any activity here, I figured I'd do a half-assed showing of the setup in my office.

Imgur gallery

The speakers are KEF LS50's driven by a Topping TP22 t-amp.

I've got 2 amps for my HD600 headphones, a Schit Magni and a Bottlehead Crack. I like having both a solid state and a tube amp depending on my mood.

The signal comes from a Macbook Pro that's mounted on the back of the monitor, to a Topping D20 DAC, then over to an old Teac equalizer to cut an obnoxious reverberation/boom bass boost I get from the hardwood floors (I'm guessing). From there it goes to the stereo signal splitter (small black box on top) that routes the signal to my headphone amps, tape deck, and back to the TP22 amplifier to power the speakers.

The audio signal can be sent to all (or none) of the amplifiers from the DAC, tape deck, or iPod (or any combination) with a push of a few buttons on the splitter, it's reeeaally handy.

I've got a tape deck in my car and I like to make mixtapes for it, it's super easy to build a playlist in Rdio and record it to tape with this setup.

Concerning the future:

As of now, the two rules listed above should be enough. However, if in the future I decide the subverse could use a new rule, I will bring it up with the community. If the community agrees with the rule, I will implement it. If the community does not agree, I won't implement the rule. I think this covers everything I want to mention about the running of this subverse. Over all, I want this to be a fun place, and I want to keep moderation to a minimum. I believe minimal intervention is the best way to run a community like this.

I'm not well-versed in CSS, and I really don't feel like putting in the time to learn how to properly code it. As such, this subverse will look like this until/unless someone who is well-versed in CSS comes around to design something custom. The most I will do is create link flairs if I feel more are needed.
